title: Intocable Announces Texicano Tour 2027: ‘A Journey Through Our Culture’
summary: The group reveals the first 21 dates of the trek, which spans the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico.
contentText:
After a year of major achievements in its career — including the unveiling of the group’s star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame, a historic performance at the Zócalo in Mexico City and six RIAA Latin Diamond certifications — Intocable has announced the first 21 dates of its Texicano Tour 2027, which kicks off on Feb. 20 in Chicago.

Spanning the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, the tour will make stops in cities including Atlanta; Nashville; Los Angeles; San Juan, Puerto Rico; and Guadalajara and Mexico City in Mexico, concluding on Nov. 9 in Monterrey, Mexico. More dates are expected to be announced.

Intocable Makes History With Six RIAA Latin Diamond Awards

Intocable Receive Star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame: ‘Thank You for Putting Us Here’

The tour’s name represents the diversity of musical influences the members of the group — formed in Hidalgo, Texas — were exposed to since childhood, influences that helped them create a revolutionary musical style within the regional Mexican genre that has endured for more than three decades.

“We never set out to fuse different genres or create a new sound. We grew up listening to country, rock, norteño, conjunto and everything in between. We never saw those sounds as part of different worlds; they were simply part of our identity,” Ricky Muñoz, vocalist and leader of Intocable, said in a statement. “Texicano is not half of anything. It’s the entirety of everything that has shaped us. That is the essence of this tour. We want the concert to feel like a journey through our culture, not just a collection of songs.”

The announcement of the Texicano Tour 2027 comes as the group wraps its Cultura Tour, which began in February. In October, Intocable was a special guest of Kacey Musgraves during a performance in Austin, Texas, following the band’s collaboration with the country star on the song “Uncertain.”

Presale tickets for the tour will begin on Thursday (Nov. 19) at 10 a.m. local time, with the general sale starting on Friday (Nov. 20) at the same time. Tickets will be available on Intocable’s official website .
